metaTitle: Deep Cycle vs Starting Battery for Camping
description: Learn how deep cycle and starting batteries differ, how to size a camping battery and why AGM or lithium suits fridges, lights and inverters.
directAnswer: A starting battery gives a short burst of current to crank an engine, while a deep cycle battery delivers steady power for hours and survives repeated deep discharges. Use a deep cycle battery for camp loads and keep it separate from the starter.
